support_how_to_book:
To book an appointment:
1. Describe symptoms in plain language on the main screen.
2. View the AI specialist recommendation.
3. Pick an expert doctor.
4. Select a date, time, and consultation mode.
5. Click Confirm!
support_waitlists: When a time slot is fully booked, you can join the waitlist. If the slot becomes free, you will get a notification and a 10-minute hold to claim it in your Dashboard.
support_modes:
We offer three modes:
1. In-Person: Visit the doctor at the clinic.
2. Video Call: Speak via live video.
3. Chat Consult: Send text messages for minor issues.
